data.name: Tag! You're Dead
data.detailed_description:
Tag! You're Dead is a fast-paced, side-scrolling horror arcade game where every second you survive makes the game harder.

Inspired by the FOUND TV film demo_n, this one-button nightmare drops you into a glitch-ridden world full of collapsing platforms, demonic traps, and sudden jump scares. You tap, dash, and jump to stay alive as the screen speeds up and the pressure builds. The farther you get, the faster it goes—and the more twisted the game becomes.

At first, it seems simple: dodge obstacles, survive the demons, and climb the leaderboard. But very quickly, you'll find yourself in a state of full-panic reflexes as the speed increases, the visuals distort, and the enemies become relentless.


It’s brutal, fast, and addictively fun—a game that dares you to try “just one more run” even after your 20th crash.

There are no checkpoints. No second chances. Just your instincts and a steadily unraveling nightmare trying to catch you.


What Makes It Unique:

  • One-button twitch gameplay

  • Creepy found footage horror aesthetic

  • Demons that get faster and smarter the longer you last

  • Retro glitch visuals and VHS-style effects

  • Original horror soundtrack that builds with intensity

Tag! You're Dead is perfect for fans of Geometry Dash, Flappy Bird, or anyone who wants a creepy, high-score arcade challenge that feels different every time.

How far can you go before the shadows catch you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 550 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard
